
```{r}
# SCRIPT 1: DATA CLEANING AND EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. IMPORT DATA

athletes_raw <- read_csv(
  "athlete_events.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

regions_raw <- read_csv(
  "noc_regions.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 2. EXPLORE ORIGINAL DATA

glimpse(athletes_raw)

summary(athletes_raw)

# Missing values by column
colSums(is.na(athletes_raw))

# Duplicate records
sum(duplicated(athletes_raw))
```

# 3. CLEAN ATHLETE DATA
```{r}
athletes <- athletes_raw %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Height = as.numeric(Height),
    Weight = as.numeric(Weight),
    Year = as.integer(Year),

    Age = if_else(
      Age < 10 | Age > 100,
      NA_real_,
      Age
    ),

    Height = if_else(
      Height < 100 | Height > 250,
      NA_real_,
      Height
    ),

    Weight = if_else(
      Weight < 25 | Weight > 300,
      NA_real_,
      Weight
    ),

    Medal = if_else(
      Medal %in% c("Gold", "Silver", "Bronze"),
      Medal,
      NA_character_
    )
  )
```
# 4. CLEAN COUNTRY INFORMATION

```{r}
regions <- regions_raw %>%
  distinct(NOC, .keep_all = TRUE)

athletes <- athletes %>%
  left_join(
    regions %>% select(NOC, region, notes),
    by = "NOC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Country = coalesce(region, Team)
  )

# Check unmatched NOC codes
unmatched_countries <- athletes %>%
  filter(is.na(region)) %>%
  distinct(NOC, Team)

write_csv(
  unmatched_countries,
  "unmatched_countries.csv"
)
```

# 5. CREATE MEDAL DATASET

```{r}
medals <- athletes %>%
  filter(!is.na(Medal))
```

# 6. COUNTRY MEDAL ANALYSIS

```{r}
# Each country receives one medal for each event at each Games.
# Team members do not create additional country medals.

country_medals <- medals %>%
  distinct(
    NOC, Country, Games, Season,
    Year, Event, Medal
  )

country_summary <- country_medals %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Gold = sum(Medal == "Gold"),
    Silver = sum(Medal == "Silver"),
    Bronze = sum(Medal == "Bronze"),
    Total = Gold + Silver + Bronze,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

# Summer medals
summer_medals <- country_medals %>%
  filter(Season == "Summer") %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

# Winter medals
winter_medals <- country_medals %>%
  filter(Season == "Winter") %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
```

# 7. ATHLETE MEDAL ANALYSIS

```{r}
athlete_medals <- medals %>%
  distinct(
    ID, Name, Games, Event, Medal
  )

athlete_summary <- athlete_medals %>%
  group_by(ID, Name) %>%
  summarise(
    Gold = sum(Medal == "Gold"),
    Silver = sum(Medal == "Silver"),
    Bronze = sum(Medal == "Bronze"),
    Total = Gold + Silver + Bronze,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
```

# 8. AGE AND PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS

```{r}
age_analysis <- athletes %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age)) %>%
  mutate(
    Performance = if_else(
      is.na(Medal),
      "Non-medal winner",
      "Medal winner"
    )
  )

age_summary <- age_analysis %>%
  group_by(Sport, Performance) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_Age = mean(Age),
    Median_Age = median(Age),
    Number_of_Athletes = n_distinct(ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 9. GENDER PARTICIPATION ANALYSIS

```{r}
gender_participation <- athletes %>%
  distinct(ID, Year, Season, Sex) %>%
  group_by(Year, Season, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Participants = n_distinct(ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 10. COUNTRY PERFORMANCE OVER TIME

```{r}
country_trends <- country_medals %>%
  group_by(NOC, Country, Year, Season) %>%
  summarise(
    Medals = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Country, Year)
```

# 12. CREATE GRAPHS

```{r}
# Top 10 countries

country_graph <- country_summary %>%
  slice_max(Total, n = 10) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Country, Total),
      y = Total
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Olympic Countries",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Total Medals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(country_graph)

ggsave(
  "top_countries.png",
  country_graph,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

# Gender participation

gender_graph <- ggplot(
  gender_participation,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = Participants,
    color = Sex
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Season) +
  labs(
    title = "Olympic Participation by Gender",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(gender_graph)

ggsave(
  "gender_participation.png",
  gender_graph,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

# Age and performance

age_graph <- ggplot(
  age_analysis,
  aes(
    x = Performance,
    y = Age,
    fill = Performance
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Sport) +
  labs(
    title = "Age and Olympic Performance",
    x = "Performance",
    y = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(age_graph)

ggsave(
  "age_performance.png",
  age_graph,
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

# Country performance over time

trend_graph <- ggplot(
  country_trends,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = Medals,
    color = Country
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Olympic Medal Trends",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Medals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(trend_graph)

ggsave(
  "country_trends.png",
  trend_graph,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```

# 14. FINAL DATA SUMMARY

```{r}
cat("\nDATA CLEANING COMPLETE\n")

cat("Original observations:",
    nrow(athletes_raw), "\n")

cat("Cleaned observations:",
    nrow(athletes), "\n")

cat("Unique athletes:",
    n_distinct(athletes$ID), "\n")

cat("Countries:",
    n_distinct(athletes$Country), "\n")

cat("Medal records:",
    nrow(medals), "\n")

cat("Olympic years:",
    min(athletes$Year, na.rm = TRUE),
    "to",
    max(athletes$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nAll cleaning and analysis files exported!\n")
```
